statements.deduction-consent-v3: I am the driver named on this paper. I have seen this charge: the reason, the evidence and the photos. I agree that I must pay {amount} in total for this charge. I agree that the company may take this amount from my salary in monthly parts. The amount taken in any one month will never be more than the legal monthly limit, and I will be shown the amount for each month before it is taken. This agreement is only for this charge. I can still object within the time written on this paper.
statements.receipt-dispute-v2: I am the driver named on this paper. I have received this charge and I have seen the reason, the evidence and the photos. I do not agree with this charge, for the reasons I wrote. My signature only shows that I received this paper. It does not mean that I agree. I can object within the time written on this paper.
statements.refusal-witness-v2: I saw this charge paper given to the driver named on it. The driver did not want to sign it or answer. The date and time of this record are set by the system.

consent.languageLabel: Language of the statement you sign
consent.photosNone: No photos attached to this charge.
consent.photosSeen: Look at the photos before you answer.
consent.readAloud: If you cannot read this, ask your supervisor to read it to you before you sign.
consent.acknowledge: I have read this statement (or it was read to me) and I agree to sign it.
consent.ksaRule: Saudi Labour Law applies to this charge. Damage or loss: at most 5 days of wage each month. Any other charge, including a traffic fine: only with your written consent. All deductions together: at most half the wage. You have 15 working days to object.
consent.otherRule: The company limit applies to this charge. This rule still needs legal confirmation for this country.
consent.photoRequired: Add at least one photo of the damage before sending this charge to the driver.
consent.otherRuleDriver: The company deduction limit applies to this charge.

validate.photoRequired: Add at least one photo of the damage. The driver sees it before answering.
validate.fineSource: A traffic fine charge must link the traffic fine record.
validate.basis: Write the basis for the charge (at least 10 characters).
validate.amount: Amount must be greater than zero.
validate.currency: Enter a three letter currency code.
validate.evidenceRow: Each evidence row needs a type, reference and description.
validate.evidenceOrSource: Link a source record or list at least one piece of evidence.
validate.explanation: Explain why you dispute the charge.

pdf.scriptUnavailable: This browser could not draw the Arabic or Urdu text. Open this PDF from Chrome, Edge or Safari to print it in that language.
